project.description: Publish a throwaway preview of your jenkins-pipelines fork into /previews. No local setup needed: the build installs the tool itself. If your fork has no committed .jenkins-preview.json, curated defaults are used (sets pxb-8.0, pxb-8.1, pxb-9.x: compile + test pipelines). The preview folder appears next to this job as preview-<service>-<NAME>.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: FORK_URL
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Git URL of YOUR jenkins-pipelines fork

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BRANCH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Branch on your fork to preview

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: SET
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Set name from the fork's committed .jenkins-preview.json

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: NAME
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Preview name, e.g. pxb-minio; becomes the folder name suffix

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ALLOW_FOREIGN_FETCH
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Acknowledge build-time fetches that leave your fork. The pxb pipelines fetch run-test and pipeline code from the canonical repo, so previews do not cover those files. Leave enabled unless your set is fully self-contained.
